sources.quote: The two legacy API model names, `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner`, will be discontinued in three months (2026-07-24). During the current period, these two model names point to the non-thinking mode and thinking mode of `deepseek-v4-flash`, respectively.
sources.supports: The changelog dates this routing change to 2026-04-24; the legacy chat endpoint now uses V4-Flash.

sources.quote: Both models support 1M context & dual modes (Thinking / Non-Thinking)
sources.supports: The April 24 V4 release introduced the 1M-context models associated with the reported update.

sources.quote: 💰 DeepSeek API prices drop 50%+, effective immediately.
sources.supports: DeepSeek announced a price change effective immediately on September 29, 2025; the attached price graphic records cache hit $0.028, cache miss $0.28, and output $0.42, establishing the prior price was official.
The official price graphic marks the start of the announced price schedule; the graphic shows $0.028 cache hit, $0.28 cache miss, and $0.42 output per million tokens.
The Internet Archive CDX endpoint returned an outage page, so archived pricing snapshots could not be checked.

notes: The former $0.28 input / $0.42 output rate was an official DeepSeek rate (with $0.028 cache-hit input). On 2026-04-24 DeepSeek dated the V4 release and said deepseek-chat now routes to V4-Flash, so the models.dev change is a provider price change with day precision. The official pages fetched here do not establish a narrower time or snapshot bracket; the archive lookup was temporarily unavailable.
